generation_review.full_prompt:
Draw exactly ONE Small Seal glyph U+3D068.
The supplied chart shows FOUR historical views of the SAME ONE Small Seal character, ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC. Compare EVERY available witness equally; any slot marked unavailable provides no evidence. Create ONE newly drawn, coherent contemporary sans-serif/Gothic glyph informed by all witnesses, selecting ONE coherent attested construction where variants differ. Never combine incompatible components or replace this with modern Chinese. Trace the real continuous writing-stroke courses using smooth rounded curves and appropriate straight segments; preserve all meaningful branches, legs, bars, counters, crossings, attachments and detachments. Each intentional stroke has the SAME CONSTANT width, approximately 3% of the full canvas, with rounded caps and joins. No brush taper, thick/thin pressure, serifs, texture, ink blobs, doubled outlines or ornamental seal effects. Output exactly ONE complete glyph, black on transparent alpha, centered within the central70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. No reference copies, four-character layout, labels, text, frames, grid, backdrop or shadows.
STRUCTURAL AND PROPORTIONAL READING:
1. All FOUR specimens available. Entire character consists of THREE horizontal bars joined by ONE continuous central vertical stem. No extra dot, side branch, descender below baseline or enclosing border.
2. Top and middle bars are CLOSE together; the gap from middle to bottom is CLEARLY LARGER, approximately2–2.5times the upper gap in a coherent CCZ/DYC-like arrangement.
3. Bottom horizontal is longest. Choose attested THX/CCZ/DYC relation: upper bar slightly shorter than bottom, middle shorter than upper (approximately bottom1.0,top0.93,middle0.85). Bars share a common center.
4. Vertical begins ON the top bar, passes THROUGH middle bar, and ENDS ON bottom bar. It does not protrude above top or below bottom. All three bars firmly attach at their centers.
5. Historical reference brush thickness is NOT to be copied. Redraw four real constant-width tube strokes, thin about3%canvas, semicircular round caps; all bar ends maintain full width until rounded cap, no elliptical taper.
Precise proportional keys: lower vertical gap much larger than upper; bottom bar longest; central vertical stops at outer bars. This is a complete simple four-stroke character, so no extra forms or decorations. Genuine constant-width geometric strokes.
